pages.name: legal_framework_professional_independence
pages.title: Part 1 - Legal framework and professional independence
pages.description: Please answer the following questions about the legal framework for official statistics in your country, and the professional independence of the national statistical authorities. Concise but informative responses are sufficient. If an issue is not applicable, please briefly explain why.

elements.name: ssa
elements.title: The Statistical Services Act dates back to 1980. Which are main issues any revision of the act in your view should address?

elements.name: legislation_overview
elements.title: Please list and briefly describe any ohter main pieces of legislation relevant for official statistics in the country, eg., as related to censues, civil registration, the civil service, data protection, etc.

elements.name: independence_appointment_dismissal
elements.title: How is professional independence ensured by national statistical legislation and in practice with regard to the appointment and dismissal procedures of top management, and freedom from any interference?

elements.name: methodology_and_sources
elements.title: To what extent are statistical methodologies and choices of data sources determined according to strictly professional considerations?

elements.name: budget_autonomy
elements.title: To what extent do the national statistical authorities have autonomy in the allocation of the budget for the production and dissemination of official statistics?

elements.name: areas_for_improvement
elements.title: What do you think needs to be improved in the area of professional independence?

elements.name: support_needed
elements.title: What support do you need from international organizations in the area of professional independence?
